description: An advanced, comprehensive clinical CRM designed for solo hypnotherapists in the USA. This database tracks client onboarding, therapeutic goals, session counts, intake status, and custom self-hypnosis audio delivery, enabling a seamless, professional client management experience.
target_audience: Solo Hypnotherapists, Clinical Hypnotists, and Mindset Coaches

client_name.description: The legal and preferred name of the hypnotherapy client.

status.description: The current stage of the client's therapeutic journey.

primary_issues.description: The core behavioral or psychological issues targeted for hypnotherapy.

sessions_completed.description: Total number of hypnotherapy sessions completed in the current treatment cycle.

next_session.description: Scheduled date and time for the next hypnotherapy or intake session.

intake_and_consent.description: Tracks the status of essential legal and medical intake forms required in the USA.

treatment_plans_relation.description: Links this client to their customized clinical treatment plans and hypnotic scripts.

session_logs_relation.description: Connects the client profile to detailed post-session clinical notes and behavioral observations.

custom_recording_link.description: Secure cloud link (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox) to the client's custom self-hypnosis audio recordings for daily reinforcement.

billing_status.description: The financial and billing status of the client's current therapeutic package.

architecture_tips: HIPAA Compliance Warning: Since Notion is not natively HIPAA-compliant out of the box without an Enterprise plan and a signed BAA, avoid storing highly sensitive medical histories or raw psychiatric diagnoses directly in plain text. Use encrypted external links or coded client IDs (e.g., Client #88301) instead of full names if necessary.

Automate Intake via Notion Forms: Connect this database to Fillout, Tally, or Typeform. When a client submits their intake/consent form, it can automatically populate the 'client_name', 'primary_issues', and change 'intake_and_consent' to 'Signed & Completed'.

Template-Driven Session Notes: Create a page template inside this database for 'New Client Profile'. Inside the template, embed a filtered view of 'DB_HYPNOTHERAPY_SESSION_LOGS' showing only session notes related to this specific client for a unified clinical dashboard.

Resource Portal Integration: Create a separate public-facing Notion page for clients where you share general self-hypnosis guides, and use the 'custom_recording_link' property to dynamically share their unique audio files directly within their personalized portal.

formulas_explained.name: Session Progress Indicator
formulas_explained.formula: if(prop("sessions_completed") == 0, "⚪ Not Started", if(prop("sessions_completed") < 4, "🌱 Initial Induction Stage", if(prop("sessions_completed") < 8, "🌀 Deepening & Reconditioning", "✨ Integration & Maintenance")))
formulas_explained.purpose: Provides visual, automated feedback on the client's progression through typical hypnotherapeutic stages based on the number of completed sessions, helping the solo practitioner quickly assess clinical trajectory.

formulas_explained.name: Next Session Alert
formulas_explained.formula: if(empty(prop("next_session")), "⚠️ Schedule Next Session", if(dateBetween(prop("next_session"), now(), "days") == 0, "🚨 Session is TODAY!", if(dateBetween(prop("next_session"), now(), "days") < 0, "⚠️ Session Needs Archive/Update", "📅 in " + format(dateBetween(prop("next_session"), now(), "days")) + " days")))
formulas_explained.purpose: A dynamic scheduling assistant that alerts the therapist if a client has no scheduled session, if a session is today, or if a past session needs to be processed and logged.
